title: OpenBao overview
description: OpenBao overview. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. See the profile validation record for tested environments and native alert coverage.

options.query:
| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_core_active")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster instance scrape_profile
| stats sum(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_audit_log_request_failure")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_audit_log_request_failure"
| eval series=case(metric_name="vault_audit_log_request_failure","audit_log_request_failure") ." | ".coalesce(openbao_namespace,"(missing)") ." | ".cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| eval value=value*300
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile series
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$

| `openbao_metric_samples("vault_cache_*")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ scrape_profile=$scrape_profile|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="vault_cache_hit" OR metric_name="vault_cache_miss"
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_cache_hit$"),value,null()))) AS hits sum(eval(if(match(metric_name,"_cache_miss$"),value,null()))) AS misses count(eval(match(metric_name,"_cache_hit$"))) AS hit_series count(eval(match(metric_name,"_cache_miss$"))) AS miss_series BY bucket_time cluster scrape_profile
| where hit_series>0 AND miss_series>0 AND hits+misses>0
| eval value=hits/(hits+misses), series=cluster ." | ".scrape_profile
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats max(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

viz_active_nodes.title: Active nodes
viz_active_nodes.description: Sum of fresh active flags across targets. A normal three-node cluster has one active node.

viz_audit_request_failures.title: Audit request failures
viz_audit_request_failures.description: Reset-corrected request audit-delivery failures over a rolling five-minute window. An absent metric is unknown, not zero.

viz_audit_stream.title: Audit stream
viz_audit_stream.description: Allowlisted audit metadata. Counts include separate request and response entries unless the query selects a type. Counts use the selected range; charts use disjoint five-minute buckets. Missing caller names do not imply anonymous access.

viz_autopilot_node_health.title: Autopilot node health
viz_autopilot_node_health.description: Raft node health by node_id. Non-voter and read-replica membership require separate interpretation.

viz_autopilot_unhealthy_nodes.title: Unhealthy Raft nodes
viz_autopilot_unhealthy_nodes.description: Autopilot node-health flags deduplicated by node_id using the minimum across reporters, then counted. This measures peer health, not voter count or quorum margin.

viz_barrier_get_latency.title: Barrier GET latency
viz_barrier_get_latency.description: Rolling five-minute mean barrier GET duration in milliseconds.

viz_barrier_put_latency.title: Barrier PUT latency
viz_barrier_put_latency.description: Rolling five-minute mean barrier PUT duration in milliseconds.

viz_cache_hit_ratio.title: Cache hit ratio
viz_cache_hit_ratio.description: Five-minute cache hit ratio from reset-corrected hit and miss counters. Both counters and at least one observation are required; idle or incomplete data remains absent. The OpenBao cache is distinct from Salt disk caching.

viz_heap_objects.title: Heap objects
viz_heap_objects.description: Maximum current heap object count across targets.

viz_in_flight_requests.title: In-flight requests
viz_in_flight_requests.description: Maximum current in-flight requests across targets.

viz_lease_count.title: Lease count
viz_lease_count.description: Tracked lease inventory, including valid and expired entries awaiting cleanup. The warning threshold is not a service limit.

viz_login_latency.title: Login latency
viz_login_latency.description: Rolling five-minute mean generic login handling duration in milliseconds. This does not isolate LDAP or client-observed latency.

viz_mount_table_entries.title: Mount table entries
viz_mount_table_entries.description: Mount inventory by bounded type and local labels. Deduplicates observations across nodes before summing categories; this does not expose mount paths.

viz_operational_errors.title: Operational errors
viz_operational_errors.description: OpenBao JSON operational logs. Only timestamp, host, severity, module, and message are exposed. Error text can contain sensitive information. Charts use disjoint five-minute buckets; this is not a client-latency measurement.

viz_raft_peers.title: Raft peers
viz_raft_peers.description: Maximum current Raft peer count. This is not the number of unsealed nodes.

viz_request_latency.title: Request latency
viz_request_latency.description: Rolling five-minute mean request handling duration in milliseconds, weighted by request count across targets.

viz_request_rate.title: Request rate
viz_request_rate.description: Rolling five-minute requests per second from cumulative summary counts, with counter reset correction.

viz_scrape_health.title: Scrape health
viz_scrape_health.description: Latest scrape success per target, then the minimum across targets. Samples older than 45 seconds are absent.

viz_sys_bytes.title: System bytes
viz_sys_bytes.description: Maximum current runtime system allocation in bytes across targets.

viz_token_check_latency.title: Token check latency
viz_token_check_latency.description: Rolling five-minute mean token validation duration in milliseconds, weighted by observations.

viz_unsealed_nodes.title: Unsealed nodes
viz_unsealed_nodes.description: Sum of fresh unsealed flags per target, preferring the cluster-labelled source over startup duplicates. Absence is unknown.
